s0301.literal: An edict approved this; six officials were appointed to each.
s0301.idiomatic: An edict approved this, and six officials were appointed to each.

s0302.literal: For the Ministry [secretariat], Sangge and Tiemuer were made grand councillors, Aruqinsaili right vice chancellor, Ye Li left vice chancellor, and Ma Shao associate administrator; the remaining one post was to be filled through deliberation by a Muslim.
s0302.idiomatic: For the ministry secretariat, Sangge and Tiemuer were made grand councillors, Aruqinsaili right vice chancellor, Ye Li left vice chancellor, and Ma Shao associate administrator; the remaining post was to be filled through deliberation by a Muslim.

s0303.literal: For the Central Secretariat, there should be two chancellors, two grand councillors, and two associate administrators.
s0303.idiomatic: For the central secretariat, there should be two chancellors, two grand councillors, and two associate administrators.

s0304.literal: The Longyou Hexi Circuit Surveillance Commission was abolished; the branch set at Gongchang was merged into Ganzhou, with five officials appointed.
s0304.idiomatic: The Longyou Hexi circuit surveillance commission was abolished; the branch set at Gongchang was merged into Ganzhou, with five officials appointed.

s0305.literal: Gongchang was transferred to the Jingzhao Surveillance Commission, with six officials appointed.
s0305.idiomatic: Gongchang was transferred to the Jingzhao surveillance commission, with six officials appointed.

s0306.literal: The Taiyuan Surveillance Commission was abolished; the branch set at Xijing was merged into Taiyuan.
s0306.idiomatic: The Taiyuan surveillance commission was abolished; the branch set at Xijing was merged into Taiyuan.

s0307.literal: On xinwei day an edict announcing the re-establishment of the Ministry secretariat was sent throughout the realm.
s0307.idiomatic: On xinwei day an edict announcing the re-establishment of the ministry secretariat was sent throughout the realm.

s0308.literal: Except that branch secretariats would deliberate with the Central Secretariat before acting, all other matters were left to the Ministry secretariat to handle as convenient and report.
s0308.idiomatic: Except that branch secretariats would deliberate with the central secretariat before acting, all other matters were left to the ministry secretariat to handle as convenient and report.

s0309.literal: The Directorate of Education was established, with directorate officials appointed: one director, two vice-directors, one supervising secretary, two academic doctors, four teaching assistants, and one hundred twenty students, half Mongol and half Han, with paper currency and food supplied by the state; it remained under the Academy of Scholarly Worthies.
s0309.idiomatic: The directorate of education was established, with one director, two vice-directors, one supervising secretary, two academic doctors, four teaching assistants, and 120 students, half Mongol and half Han, with paper currency and food supplied by the state; it remained under the Academy of Scholarly Worthies.

s0310.literal: Confucian education intendant offices were established in each Jiangnan circuit.
s0310.idiomatic: Confucian education intendant offices were established in each Jiangnan circuit.

s0311.literal: On jiashen day the moon transgressed Niulang.
s0311.idiomatic: On jiashen day the moon transgressed Niulang.

s0312.literal: The imperial procession returned to the palace.
s0312.idiomatic: The imperial procession returned to the palace.

s0313.literal: On yiyou day Zilai Route was renamed Panyang Route and a records office was established.
s0313.idiomatic: On yiyou day Zilai Route was renamed Panyang Route and a records office was established.

s0314.literal: Famine in Dadu; this year's silver salary notes were remitted, while the various routes collected half.
s0314.idiomatic: Famine in Dadu; this year's silver salary notes were remitted, while the various routes collected half.

s0315.literal: Taxes on Jiangnan bamboo, timber, firewood, and fish-market duties were abolished, and unpaid services were suspended.
s0315.idiomatic: Taxes on Jiangnan bamboo, timber, firewood, and fish-market duties were abolished, and unpaid services were suspended.

s0316.literal: An order directed branch secretariat and pacification commission offices not to recommend officials recklessly; those who had received appointments but delayed taking office for months were to have their appointment documents revoked.
s0316.idiomatic: An order directed branch secretariat and pacification commission offices not to recommend officials recklessly; those who had received appointments but delayed taking office for months were to have their appointment documents revoked.

s0317.literal: Prince of Zhennan Tuohuan was transferred to guard Nanjing.
s0317.idiomatic: Prince of Zhennan Tuohuan was transferred to guard Nanjing.

s0318.literal: The Fujian Maritime Trade and Transport Commission was renamed the Salt Transport Commission.
s0318.idiomatic: The Fujian maritime trade and transport commission was renamed the salt transport commission.

s0319.literal: Fan Wenhu was made right vice chancellor of the Ministry secretariat to deliberate on Privy Council affairs.
s0319.idiomatic: Fan Wenhu was made right vice chancellor of the ministry secretariat to deliberate on privy council affairs.

s0320.literal: The Branch Central Secretariat was renamed the Branch Ministry secretariat; the Six Ministries became the Six Ministries of Revenue; Xindu, Minister of Personnel, was made associate administrator of the Ministry secretariat.
s0320.idiomatic: The branch central secretariat was renamed the branch ministry secretariat; the six ministries became the six ministries of revenue; Xindu, minister of personnel, was made associate administrator of the ministry secretariat.

s0321.literal: On gengyin day the imperial procession proceeded to Shangdu.
s0321.idiomatic: On gengyin day the imperial procession proceeded to Shangdu.

s0322.literal: Jalhuqa Helegesun and others said: "Last year the judicial review officials recorded prisoners; in Nanjing and Jinan circuits alone those deserving death already numbered one hundred ninety; if all routes were checked, the total would surely be large — Jalhuqa and several others should be retained to carry out executions in separate districts.
s0322.idiomatic: Jalhuqa Helegesun and others said, "Last year the judicial review officials recorded prisoners; in Nanjing and Jinan circuits alone those deserving death already numbered 190; if all routes were checked, the total would surely be large — Jalhuqa and several others should be retained to carry out executions in separate districts.

s0323.literal: " The Emperor said: "Prisoners are not a flock of sheep — how can they be killed in haste?
s0323.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Prisoners are not a flock of sheep — how can they be killed in haste?

s0324.literal: All should be assigned to gold-panning labor."
s0324.idiomatic: All should be assigned to gold-panning labor."

s0325.literal: Third month, jiawu day: new Zhiyuan treasure notes were minted and issued throughout the realm; Zhongtong notes continued to circulate as before.
s0325.idiomatic: Third month, jiawu day: new Zhiyuan treasure notes were minted and issued throughout the realm; Zhongtong notes continued to circulate as before.

s0326.literal: One string of Zhiyuan treasure notes equaled five strings of Zhongtong exchange notes; parent and child notes were mutually balanced, the aim being that the new would not be excessive and the old would not be abolished.
s0326.idiomatic: One string of Zhiyuan treasure notes equaled five strings of Zhongtong exchange notes; parent and child notes were mutually balanced, the aim being that the new would not be excessive and the old would not be abolished.

s0327.literal: All annual grants, relief for the needy, and military provisions were reckoned in Zhongtong notes as the standard.
s0327.idiomatic: All annual grants, relief for the needy, and military provisions were reckoned in Zhongtong notes as the standard.

s0328.literal: Unregistered men who volunteered for military service and harassed civilians were forbidden; they were enrolled as garrison troops.
s0328.idiomatic: Unregistered men who volunteered for military service and harassed civilians were forbidden; they were enrolled as garrison troops.

s0329.literal: On bingshen day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.
s0329.idiomatic: On bingshen day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.

s0330.literal: On yimao day the Emperor visited Liang Pass.
s0330.idiomatic: On yimao day the Emperor visited Liang Pass.

s0331.literal: Famine in Liaodong; the ban on fishing in the Taizi River was relaxed.
s0331.idiomatic: Famine in Liaodong; the ban on fishing in the Taizi River was relaxed.

s0332.literal: On bingchen day the kingdom of Ma Ba'er sent envoys presenting one strange beast, resembling a mule but huge, with black and white intermingled fur, named Atabij.
s0332.idiomatic: On bingchen day the kingdom of Ma Ba'er sent envoys presenting one strange beast, resembling a mule but huge, with black and white intermingled fur, named Atabij.

s0333.literal: Dingyuan Prefecture in Chongqing Route was downgraded to a county.
s0333.idiomatic: Dingyuan Prefecture in Chongqing Route was downgraded to a county.

s0334.literal: The Directorate of Waterways was ordered to open the Wen and Si rivers to reach the capital.
s0334.idiomatic: The directorate of waterways was ordered to open the Wen and Si rivers to reach the capital.

s0335.literal: The Bianliang river flooded; seven thousand laborers repaired the old embankments.
s0335.idiomatic: The Bianliang river flooded; 7,000 laborers repaired the old embankments.

s0336.literal: Summer, fourth month, guiyou day: the moon transgressed Di.
s0336.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, guiyou day: the moon transgressed Di.

s0337.literal: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed Fang.
s0337.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed Fang.

s0338.literal: On jiashen day Xindu memorialized dispatching one hundred ten thousand six hundred ingots of new notes, one thousand five hundred ninety-three ingots of silver, and one hundred taels of gold to the Jiangnan branch secretariats for mutual trade with the people.
s0338.idiomatic: On jiashen day Xindu memorialized dispatching 110,600 ingots of new notes, 1,593 ingots of silver, and 100 taels of gold to the Jiangnan branch secretariats for mutual trade with the people.

s0340.literal: Fifth month, jihai day: Yexian was dispatched with an imperial message to the Beijing and other pacification commissions: all subjects under Nayan's jurisdiction were forbidden to travel back and forth, nor permitted to ride horses or carry bows and arrows.
s0340.idiomatic: Fifth month, jihai day: Yexian was dispatched with an imperial message to the Beijing and other pacification commissions; all subjects under Nayan's jurisdiction were forbidden to travel back and forth, nor permitted to ride horses or carry bows and arrows.

s0341.literal: On gengzi day Bulughan was placed in overall command of three thousand tammaq for the campaign.
s0341.idiomatic: On gengzi day Bulughan was placed in overall command of 3,000 tammaq for the campaign.

s0342.literal: The Jinan Pacification Commission moved its seat to Yidu; the Yannan Surveillance Commission to Daming; the Nanjing Surveillance Commission to Nanyang; the Taiyuan Surveillance Commission to Xijing; and Fengzhou Yilaizhen relay station was re-established.
s0342.idiomatic: The Jinan pacification commission moved its seat to Yidu; the Yannan surveillance commission to Daming; the Nanjing surveillance commission to Nanyang; the Taiyuan surveillance commission to Xijing; and Fengzhou Yilaizhen relay station was re-established.

s0343.literal: On renyin day, because censorate clerk Wang Liangbi and others had slandered Ministry secretariat policies, Liangbi was executed, his property confiscated, and the rest all sentenced.
s0343.idiomatic: On renyin day, because censorate clerk Wang Liangbi and others had slandered ministry secretariat policies, Liangbi was executed, his property confiscated, and the rest all sentenced.

s0344.literal: Following Sangge's recommendation, Shanghai and Fuzhou myriarch offices were established to restrain Shabudin, Umar, and others' sea-transport ships.
s0344.idiomatic: Following Sangge's recommendation, Shanghai and Fuzhou myriarch offices were established to restrain Shabudin, Umar, and others' sea-transport ships.

s0345.literal: Two additional ministers were added to each of the Ministries of Revenue and Works.
s0345.idiomatic: Two additional ministers were added to each of the ministries of revenue and works.

s0346.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo was granted Branch Ministry secretariat grand councillor.
s0346.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo was granted branch ministry secretariat grand councillor.

s0347.literal: Relay-station toqtoghusun on various routes were abolished.
s0347.idiomatic: Relay-station toqtoghusun on various routes were abolished.

s0348.literal: Artisan households in the Jiangnan routes were registered.
s0348.idiomatic: Artisan households in the Jiangnan routes were registered.

s0349.literal: Shabudin said: "Southern officials in Jiangnan branch secretariats are numerous; each province should use one or two.
s0349.idiomatic: Shabudin said, "Southern officials in Jiangnan branch secretariats are numerous; each province should use one or two.

s0350.literal: " The Emperor said: "Except for the four men Chen Yan, Lü Shiyao, Guan Rude, and Fan Wenhu, the rest follow your recommendation.
s0350.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Except for the four men Chen Yan, Lü Shiyao, Guan Rude, and Fan Wenhu, the rest follow your recommendation.

s0351.literal: " The Emperor personally led the campaign against Nayan, departing from Shangdu.
s0351.idiomatic: " The Emperor personally led the campaign against Nayan, departing from Shangdu.

s0352.literal: Horses of Buddhist and Daoist clergy in Jiangnan were registered.
s0352.idiomatic: Horses of Buddhist and Daoist clergy in Jiangnan were registered.

s0353.literal: An edict directed Fan Wenhu to garrison Pingluan with five hundred imperial guard troops; Qincha was made chief commander of the personal guard army, with Yesudai'er and Right Guard deputy Wang Tong as his deputies.
s0353.idiomatic: An edict directed Fan Wenhu to garrison Pingluan with 500 imperial guard troops; Qincha was made chief commander of the personal guard army, with Yesudai'er and Right Guard deputy Wang Tong as his deputies.

s0354.literal: On jiachen day this year's silk and silver taxes in Beijing were remitted, and because troops had passed through, three thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
s0354.idiomatic: On jiachen day this year's silk and silver taxes in Beijing were remitted, and because troops had passed through, 3,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

s0355.literal: On renzi day King Wang Chun of Goryeo requested additional troops for the campaign against Nayan; five hundred men were sent.
s0355.idiomatic: On renzi day King Wang Chun of Goryeo requested additional troops for the campaign against Nayan; 500 men were sent.

s0356.literal: Sixth month, gengshen new moon: officials who could not join the campaign against Nayan because of their duties wished to present horses to supply the guards.
s0356.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengshen new moon: officials who could not join the campaign against Nayan because of their duties wished to present horses to supply the guards.

s0357.literal: On renxu day the army reached Sa'erdu'lu.
s0357.idiomatic: On renxu day the army reached Sa'erdu'lu.

s0358.literal: Nayan's partisan Tabudai led his force of sixty thousand to approach the imperial camp and form battle lines; advance troops were sent and defeated them.
s0358.idiomatic: Nayan's partisan Tabudai led his force of 60,000 to approach the imperial camp and form battle lines; advance troops were sent and defeated them.

s0359.literal: On yichou day Liaoyang Province was ordered to supervise transport of military provisions.
s0359.idiomatic: On yichou day Liaoyang Province was ordered to supervise transport of military provisions.

s0360.literal: On renshen day ten thousand guard troops and one thousand Mongol troops were dispatched to garrison Hao and Yizhou.
s0360.idiomatic: On renshen day 10,000 guard troops and 1,000 Mongol troops were dispatched to garrison Hao and Yizhou.

s0361.literal: Prince Shetu'er's follower Tiege led his partisans to seize Xianping Prefecture, crossed the Liao River, and intended to plunder Hao and Yizhou; the defending officials, lacking troops, sought aid, and an edict sent one thousand Beijing garrison troops.
s0361.idiomatic: Prince Shetu'er's follower Tiege led his partisans to seize Xianping Prefecture, crossed the Liao River, and intended to plunder Hao and Yizhou; the defending officials, lacking troops, sought aid, and an edict sent 1,000 Beijing garrison troops.

s0362.literal: Horses in Pingluan Route were registered.
s0362.idiomatic: Horses in Pingluan Route were registered.

s0363.literal: Famine in Beijing; silk, silver, and land taxes were remitted.
s0363.idiomatic: Famine in Beijing; silk, silver, and land taxes were remitted.

s0364.literal: On yihai day heavy rain damaged crops in Yijin County, Bazhou.
s0364.idiomatic: On yihai day heavy rain damaged crops in Yijin County, Bazhou.

s0365.literal: Using idle land in Jing, Bin, and Qian prefectures of Shaanxi and counties subordinate to Anxi, a military colony commission was established with a staff of third rank.
s0365.idiomatic: Using idle land in Jing, Bin, and Qian prefectures of Shaanxi and counties subordinate to Anxi, a military colony commission was established with a staff of third rank.

s0366.literal: The imperial procession encamped at Gandali Woluotuo; more than one thousand of Nayan's supply wagons were captured, while strict orders forbade the slightest violation.
s0366.idiomatic: The imperial procession encamped at Gandali Woluotuo; more than 1,000 of Nayan's supply wagons were captured, while strict orders forbade the slightest violation.

s0367.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guisi day: Nayan's partisan Shetu'er invaded Xianping; pacification commissioner Tacu followed Prince Aiyachi, combined forces, and advanced from Shenzhou to attack; pacification commissioner Yiersahe divided troops toward Yizhou; their partisans were all pacified.
s0367.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, guisi day: Nayan's partisan Shetu'er invaded Xianping; pacification commissioner Tacu followed Prince Aiyachi, combined forces, and advanced from Shenzhou to attack; pacification commissioner Yiersahe divided troops toward Yizhou; their partisans were all pacified.

s0368.literal: On dingyou day an artisan official of Hongzhou presented fabric like Western brocade made from dog and rabbit fur, and was appointed artisan official and prefect of Hongzhou.
s0368.idiomatic: On dingyou day an artisan official of Hongzhou presented fabric like Western brocade made from dog and rabbit fur, and was appointed artisan official and prefect of Hongzhou.

s0369.literal: On wuxu day the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
s0369.idiomatic: On wuxu day the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

s0370.literal: The Privy Council memorialized: "Acting Burma expedition branch secretariat commissioner Hesairihaiya reported that on reaching Burma, when he urged the king to come to court, the king said neighboring tribes had repeatedly rebelled and it was not easy to depart immediately; it was proposed to send Anadara to present a memorial and local tribute and enter audience.
s0370.idiomatic: The privy council memorialized, "Acting Burma expedition branch secretariat commissioner Hesairihaiya reported that on reaching Burma, when he urged the king to come to court, the king said neighboring tribes had repeatedly rebelled and it was not easy to depart immediately; it was proposed to send Anadara to present a memorial and local tribute and enter audience.

s0371.literal: " On xinchou day the moon transgressed Niulang.
s0371.idiomatic: " On xinchou day the moon transgressed Niulang.

s0372.literal: On renyin day Mars transgressed Ghost.
s0372.idiomatic: On renyin day Mars transgressed Ghost.

s0373.literal: On gengxu day Yunnan branch secretariat official Ailu reported that Jinchi chiefs Daben and his brothers sought to submit and also requested audience at court.
s0373.idiomatic: On gengxu day Yunnan branch secretariat official Ailu reported that Jinchi chiefs Daben and his brothers sought to submit and also requested audience at court.

s0374.literal: On renzi day the moon transgressed Siguai.
s0374.idiomatic: On renzi day the moon transgressed Siguai.

s0375.literal: On guichou day the sun showed linked halos, and a white rainbow pierced through them.
s0375.idiomatic: On guichou day the sun showed linked halos, and a white rainbow pierced through them.

s0376.literal: Officials appointed by Nayan — darughachi in Yidu and Pingluan, Yebogan in Hejian appanage, and officials in Jinan appanage under Shengnahe'er — were all dismissed.
s0376.idiomatic: Officials appointed by Nayan — darughachi in Yidu and Pingluan, Yebogan in Hejian appanage, and officials in Jinan appanage under Shengnahe'er — were all dismissed.

s0377.literal: The Beijing Surveillance Commission moved its seat to Haozhou; corvée and taxes for troops and civilians in Dongjing and other places were remitted.
s0377.idiomatic: The Beijing surveillance commission moved its seat to Haozhou; corvée and taxes for troops and civilians in Dongjing and other places were remitted.

s0378.literal: The Fujian Salt Transport Commission was promoted, following the Two Huai precedent, to a Directorate of Salt Transport.
s0378.idiomatic: The Fujian salt transport commission was promoted, following the Two Huai precedent, to a directorate of salt transport.

s0379.literal: Zhongxing Prefecture was placed under the Ganzhou Branch Secretariat; military colonists under Hexi prince Aiyachi together with Shazhou residents repaired city walls and riverworks in Xigua, Sha, and other places.
s0379.idiomatic: Zhongxing Prefecture was placed under the Ganzhou branch secretariat; military colonists under Hexi prince Aiyachi together with Shazhou residents repaired city walls and riverworks in Xigua, Sha, and other places.

s0380.literal: A military colony was established at Chetian.
s0380.idiomatic: A military colony was established at Chetian.

s0381.literal: Eighth month, guihai day: Venus transgressed Kang.
s0381.idiomatic: Eighth month, guihai day: Venus transgressed Kang.

s0382.literal: Junzhou presented auspicious wheat, one stalk with nine ears.
s0382.idiomatic: Junzhou presented auspicious wheat, one stalk with nine ears.

s0383.literal: On yichou day the imperial procession returned to Shangdu.
s0383.idiomatic: On yichou day the imperial procession returned to Shangdu.

s0384.literal: Li Hailasun was made associate administrator of the Burma expedition branch secretariat; he led five thousand newly submitted troops and one thousand tammaq on the expedition; five thousand troops from the Sichuan and Huguang branch secretariats were also mobilized to join.
s0384.idiomatic: Li Hailasun was made associate administrator of the Burma expedition branch secretariat; he led 5,000 newly submitted troops and 1,000 tammaq on the expedition; 5,000 troops from the Sichuan and Huguang branch secretariats were also mobilized to join.

s0385.literal: Zhang Cheng, who knew the routes through the White Yi and Jinchi, and former Champa army commander Liu Quan were both summoned and made pacification commissioners, granted tiger tallies, and joined the expedition.
s0385.idiomatic: Zhang Cheng, who knew the routes through the White Yi and Jinchi, and former Champa army commander Liu Quan were both summoned and made pacification commissioners, granted tiger tallies, and joined the expedition.

s0386.literal: Tuomadai'er was made commander-in-chief, leading five thousand Sichuan troops to the Burma secretariat; the secretariat was also ordered to encamp near Burma and await further orders.
s0386.idiomatic: Tuomadai'er was made commander-in-chief, leading 5,000 Sichuan troops to the Burma secretariat; the secretariat was also ordered to encamp near Burma and await further orders.

s0387.literal: Paper currency intendant offices for the four Jiangnan branch secretariats were established.
s0387.idiomatic: Paper currency intendant offices for the four Jiangnan branch secretariats were established.

s0388.literal: On jisi day princes who had followed the rebellion were banished to serve in the Jiangnan branch secretariats to redeem themselves through military service.
s0388.idiomatic: On jisi day princes who had followed the rebellion were banished to serve in the Jiangnan branch secretariats to redeem themselves through military service.

s0389.literal: Prince of Zhennan Tuohuan was instructed to restrain the campaign princes and provincial officials including olje'u, not to allow troops to burn and plunder, and not to treat the small state of Annam lightly.
s0389.idiomatic: Prince of Zhennan Tuohuan was instructed to restrain the campaign princes and provincial officials including olje'u, not to allow troops to burn and plunder, and not to treat the small state of Annam lightly.

s0390.literal: On guiyou day Doreduohai captured rebel prince Achisi and pardoned him.
s0390.idiomatic: On guiyou day Doreduohai captured rebel prince Achisi and pardoned him.

s0391.literal: Military colony commissioner Hudulu of Yijinai Route requested dredging of waterways within his jurisdiction; this was approved.
s0391.idiomatic: Military colony commissioner Hudulu of Yijinai Route requested dredging of waterways within his jurisdiction; this was approved.

s0392.literal: On bingzi day Saturn transgressed Leibi Formation in the south.
s0392.idiomatic: On bingzi day Saturn transgressed Leibi Formation in the south.

s0393.literal: On jimao day the moon transgressed Tianguan.
s0393.idiomatic: On jimao day the moon transgressed Tianguan.

s0394.literal: On xinsi day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.
s0394.idiomatic: On xinsi day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.

s0395.literal: On jiashen day Venus transgressed Fang.
s0395.idiomatic: On jiashen day Venus transgressed Fang.

s0396.literal: On dinghai day famine struck Shenzhou, which had also been trampled by Nayan's rebel troops; this year's silk, silver, and land taxes were remitted.
s0396.idiomatic: On dinghai day famine struck Shenzhou, which had also been trampled by Nayan's rebel troops; this year's silk, silver, and land taxes were remitted.

s0397.literal: Three thousand logging households from Beijing were stationed for military colonization in Pingluan.
s0397.idiomatic: Three thousand logging households from Beijing were stationed for military colonization in Pingluan.

s0398.literal: Three offices — Fengshan, Changguo, and Jimin — were established at fifth rank, each with one darughachi, director, vice-director, and supervising clerk.
s0398.idiomatic: Three offices — Fengshan, Changguo, and Jimin — were established at fifth rank, each with one darughachi, director, vice-director, and supervising clerk.

s0399.literal: The Women's Kingdom presented sea people.
s0399.idiomatic: The Women's Kingdom presented sea people.

s0400.literal: A horse relay station was established at Hexi Station.
s0400.idiomatic: A horse relay station was established at Hexi Station.
